_about: Dancetopia quests: the NPCs on the beach and the quests they give. The SAME file is the PlayCanvas JSON asset quests.json (Scripts); change both. Rules: quest-rules.mjs (also shared). kind: 'intro' = once per player, in order per NPC; 'daily' = dailyCount of them a day (distinct NPCs, picked per player). goal.event: show (a dance show: minGrade, difficulty, minDancers, fullCombo), fashion (a fashion show: maxPlace), wear (a new look saved), buy (a wardrobe piece bought), kick (the volleyball hit), rally (hits in a row: min), dog (the dog's happy hop), find (an item at one of `spots`: entities of that name under QuestSpots in the beach scene; `item` = what's shown there). NPC spots are entities of the NPC's id under NPCs in the beach scene.

mira.name: Mira
mira.title: Dance coach
chat: Feel the beat, then hit the paw right on it!
Hard mode has more arrows. More arrows, more points!
Dancing with others? Everyone's score counts on the same board.

hana.name: Hana
hana.title: Stylist
chat: A look is half the show, darling.
Vinyl pieces are rare. Wear them with pride!
On the runway, match the theme and own the walk.

seo.name: Seo
seo.title: Volleyball captain
chat: Run into the ball to bump it. Faster run, bigger hit!
Nobody has beaten my rally record yet.
Sand courts are the best courts.

nari.name: Nari
nari.title: Mochi's owner
chat: Mochi loves visitors. Walk up and say hi!
Mochi hops when she's happy. That's her dance.
The cat bush is Mochi's favourite spot.

jiwoo.name: Jiwoo
jiwoo.title: Fisher
chat: The sea's calm today. Good for fishing, good for dancing.
Starfish wash up all over this beach.
From the end of the pier you can see the whole resort.

sora.name: Sora
sora.title: DJ
chat: Every song here has its own beat. Learn them all!
Up here you can hear the whole beach dancing.
New tracks drop all the time. Keep an ear out!

text.title: First dance
text.offer: Hi! New on the beach? Show me your moves: dance any song. Press PLAY!
text.hint: Dance any song. PLAY is at the bottom right.
text.done: Look at you go! You're a natural.

text.title: Grade A
text.offer: Now let's polish it. Type the arrows, then hit the beat right on the paw. Get an A or better!
text.hint: Get grade A or better in any song.
text.done: An A! The crowd loved that.

text.title: Turn it up
text.offer: Ready for the real stage? Finish a song on HARD. More arrows, more points!
text.hint: Finish any song on HARD.
text.done: You survived Hard mode! I'm so proud of you.

text.title: New look
text.offer: Oh, you have potential! Try on something new: tap DRESS UP and save a fresh look.
text.hint: Change your outfit in DRESS UP.
text.done: Gorgeous! Now that's a look.

text.title: Runway debut
text.offer: A look like that belongs on the runway. Join a fashion show with the FASHION button!
text.hint: Walk in a fashion show (FASHION button).
text.done: You owned that runway, darling!

text.title: Shopping spree
text.offer: Every star needs a signature piece. Buy something new in DRESS UP!
text.hint: Buy a piece in DRESS UP.
text.done: Great pick! Here's a little something back.

text.title: Bump it!
text.offer: Hey! Want to play? Run into the volleyball to bump it. Hit it 5 times!
text.hint: Hit the volleyball 5 times.
text.done: Nice hands! Well, nice everything.

text.title: Keep it up
text.offer: Now the tricky part: hit it 3 times in a row before it touches the ground!
text.hint: Hit the ball 3 times in a row without it landing.
text.done: Whoa, a real rally! Join the team any time.

text.title: Meet Mochi
text.offer: Have you met Mochi? She's right by the cat bush. Go say hi!
text.hint: Walk up to Mochi the dog.
text.done: She hopped for you! That means she likes you.

text.title: Lucky starfish
text.offer: The tide brought in some glowing starfish. They're lucky! Can you find 5 of them around the beach?
text.hint: Find 5 glowing starfish around the beach.
text.done: Five lucky starfish! Something good is coming your way.

text.title: Lost beats
text.offer: Oh no, the wind blew my beats all over the beach! Bring back 5 music notes?
text.hint: Find 5 music notes around the beach.
text.done: My beats! Now this track can drop.

text.title: Daily practice
text.offer: Practice makes perfect! Dance 3 songs today.
text.hint: Dance 3 songs today.
text.done: Three songs! Your feet must be tired.

text.title: Star dancer
text.offer: Today's challenge: get an S in any song!
text.hint: Get grade S or better in any song.
text.done: An S! Star dancer material.

text.title: No misses
text.offer: Can you dance a whole song without a single BAD or MISS? A full combo!
text.hint: Get a FULL COMBO in any song.
text.done: Full combo! Flawless.

text.title: Dance together
text.offer: Music is better with friends. Dance a song with at least one other player!
text.hint: Dance a song with other players.
text.done: That's what the beach is all about!

text.title: Note hunt
text.offer: The sea breeze scattered my notes again! Find 5 of them for me?
text.hint: Find 5 music notes around the beach.
text.done: Thank you! Tonight's set is saved.

text.title: Podium look
text.offer: Today, I want to see you on the podium. Finish top 3 in a fashion show!
text.hint: Finish top 3 in a fashion show.
text.done: On the podium! I knew it.

text.title: Fresh fit
text.offer: Yesterday's look is so yesterday. Save a new look in DRESS UP!
text.hint: Change your outfit in DRESS UP.
text.done: Fresh! Very today.

text.title: Rally time
text.offer: Warm-up time! Hit the volleyball 3 times in a row.
text.hint: Hit the ball 3 times in a row without it landing.
text.done: Great rally! Same time tomorrow?

text.title: Starfish hunt
text.offer: The tide's out and the lucky starfish are back. Find 5 of them!
text.hint: Find 5 glowing starfish around the beach.
text.done: Five more! Luck is on your side today.

text.title: Mochi time
text.offer: Mochi gets lonely. Visit her 3 times today? Walk away and come back so she hops again!
text.hint: Make Mochi hop 3 times (walk away, come back).
text.done: Mochi's tail hasn't stopped wagging!
